# Timesheet

> Time tracking for freelancers and small agencies who bill by the hour. Free forever, no credit card required.

Timesheet is a web app for tracking billable hours across multiple clients and projects. Start a timer in one click, organize entries by client/project with per-project hourly rates, tag entries for reporting, and export a CSV or print/PDF for invoicing. A browser extension lets you start/stop the timer from any tab. Available in English and French.

## Key facts

- Pricing: free forever, no credit card.
- Core feature: one-click timer with project search and description autocomplete.
- Organization: multi-client, multi-project, with hourly rate per project.
- Tags: label entries as billable/non-billable or by category.
- Export: CSV export and print/PDF, for invoicing.
- Browser extension: start/stop from any tab, keyboard shortcut, idle detection, dark mode.
- Reminders: nudges the user during work hours if no timer is running.
- Languages: English, French.
- Sign up: /auth?mode=signup
- Sign in: /auth
